authorization.scope: ChatGPT for Chrome extension may read the two open Kahana volumes in the signed-in Psik library session for every remaining source pass. Only volume A was used for these Wisdom units.

sourcePolicy: Displayed Kahana scan approved by user supersedes previous local-PDF-only acquisition choice. Existing original-PDF page locators and all prior scalars remain unchanged. Screenshot is not claimed pixel-identical to original local PDF. No OCR, grammatical reconstruction, sharpening, smoothing or alternate witness used to supply marks. Browser zoom is the ordinary viewer renderer; subsequent inspection crops may only copy pixels and use integer NEAREST.
